articles.title: 'Starlink would help the least served in India, especially in rural areas': Elon Musk
articles.summary: India Business News: Elon Musk has backed Starlink’s satellite internet service for India, saying it could help bridge connectivity gaps for some of the country’s “least s.
articles.body: Elon Musk has backed Starlink’s satellite internet service for India, saying it could help bridge connectivity gaps for some of the country’s “least served” communities, particularly in rural areas.Taking to X, the tech mogul said, “Starlink would help the least served in India, especially in rural areas.” Musk made the remark while resharing a post by DogeDesigner, which said more than 11,000 of India’s listed villages had no access to 4G as of May.The post cited data claiming that the country had 1.093 billion internet subscriptions as of March 2026, including 440.87 million in rural areas. Rural internet density stood at 48.31 subscriptions per 100 people, compared with 126.80 in urban areas.It also highlighted the progress made under BharatNet, saying more than 850,000 route-km of fibre had been laid and around 221,000 Gram Panchayats had been made service-ready. However, Points of Presence were operational in only 80,472 Gram Panchayats as of June 2026.According to the post, Starlink could help bridge connectivity gaps arising from difficult terrain, low commercial viability and infrastructure constraints. Its satellite network could reach remote villages, mountainous regions, islands and disaster-hit areas, while direct-to-device connectivity could help keep mobile phones connected beyond the reach of conventional towers.“The Indian government should complete the remaining clearances, allocate spectrum and clear Starlink for commercial launch ASAP. India has already waited far too long,” the post stated.Meanwhile, Musk’s internet firm, Starlink, is seeking to launch its satellite broadband services in India as the government is working on the regulatory framework for allocating spectrum for satellite services.Separately, Starlink business operations vice president Lauren Dreyer said the company remains in active discussions with the Centre over the launch of its commercial satellite internet services.Her comments came after media reports claimed that India had frozen the approval process over geopolitical and security concerns, including concerns reportedly linked to the use of Starlink terminals during the Iran conflict.The report said security agencies had raised objections over concerns about controlling a United States-based operator during periods of geopolitical tension.Dreyer rejected the claims, saying, “Starlink remains in active and productive discussions with the Government of India contrary to misleading stories based upon unsubstantiated claims from anonymous sources.”Get the latest Business News and Live updates. articles.title: SIM card rules 2026: What changes from August 24 and how many connections can you have
articles.summary: India Business News: The government has directed telecom service providers to stop individuals from obtaining mobile connections beyond the prescribed limit of nine, with .
articles.body: The government has directed telecom service providers to stop individuals from obtaining mobile connections beyond the prescribed limit of nine, with a new system coming into effect from August 24.Under the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) instructions, telecom companies will have to identify subscribers who seek a new mobile connection after already reaching the maximum number allowed in their name and inform them that another connection cannot be provided.The move will initially operate on a post-facto basis, allowing telecom operators to carry out the verification one day after a connection is enrolled.However, the government has asked operators to shift to a real-time system for identifying and preventing excess connections by November 30.How the new SIM verification system will workFrom August 24, telecom operators will have to take technical and organisational measures to identify subscribers attempting to obtain connections beyond the prescribed limit.The DoT circular said: “From 24.8.2026 onward, TSPs shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to identify each subscriber who seeks to obtain mobile connections beyond the prescribed limit using the representative image of the photo of a subscriber....and communicate to him that he already has maximum number of mobile connections permitted to an individual and accordingly, a new mobile connection cannot be provided to him.”To help operators carry out these checks, the DoT will make available on the Digital Intelligence Platform (DIP) from August 23 a representative image of the photograph of every subscriber who has already reached the prescribed limit.Telecom companies will have to download these images daily and use them to identify subscribers attempting to obtain additional mobile connections.Until the system is fully implemented on a post-facto basis, any connection activated beyond the permitted limit during a day will have to be immediately suspended until the issue is resolved.How many mobile connections can you have?Under existing DoT instructions issued on August 9, 2012, an individual can hold a maximum of nine mobile connections in their name across all telecom operators and licensed service areas in India.However, a lower limit applies in certain regions:Most of India: Maximum 9 mobile connectionsJammu and Kashmir: Maximum 6Assam: Maximum 6North-East: Maximum 6Customers are also required to provide a declaration in the Customer Application Form (CAF) stating the mobile connections already held in their name across telecom operators and licensed service areas.When will the new system become fully real-time?The government has set August 24 as the date from which telecom operators must begin identifying subscribers trying to obtain connections beyond the permitted limit.The initial system can operate on a post-facto basis, but telecom operators have been directed to integrate the checks into the enrolment and activation process in real time by November 30.The respective Licensed Service Areas (LSAs) will be the competent authorities to decide issues arising from implementation of the instructions.The DoT has directed telecom operators to decline new connections to subscribers who already have the maximum number of permitted SIM cards.Get the latest Business News and Live updates. articles.title: 72-year-old hardware store shuts down, chain closes 12 locations
articles.summary: Kuipers Ace Hardware in Minnesota closes in December as the owner was unable to renegotiate the store’s lease.
articles.body:
Local independent hardware stores face fierce competition from big-box home improvement stores like Home Depot and Lowe's, which requires local stores to curb their expenses and keep their prices down to compete.

One of retailers' biggest expenses which continues to rise is their store rent. If a store owner can't negotiate an affordable lease with their landlord, the shop will either need to relocate or shut down permanently.

And that's the problem facing Minnesota-based Kuipers Ace Hardware, whose 72-year history is coming to an end.

Kuipers Ace Hardware in Golden Valley, Minn., is conducting a store closing liquidation sale and plans to permanently shut down by the end of the year.

The Ace Hardware store near Minneapolis, which has anchored the Golden Valley Shopping Center since 1954, is closing after its owner Dale Hoffman failed to reach a lease agreement with the center's new landlord.

Hoffman, who began working at the store when he was 9 years old, said the decision to close was based on sustainability after lease negotiations with the shopping center's management collapsed, according to CCX Media .

"Our customers have just been fantastic, and we're sorry it had to happen this way," Hoffman said. "They're understanding and they're supporting us. It's going to be a tough one."

Kuipers Ace Hardware is conducting a store-closing liquidation sale, with many items at 50% off, according to signs posted on the store's windows. The store will remain open through the end of December or whenever all of the shop's inventory is sold.

The closing of Kuipers Ace Hardware will follow at least 11 other independently owned Ace Hardware store closures across the country in 2026 for various reasons, such as ownership retirement or financial distress.

Independent Ace Hardware store owners closed stores in San Dimas, Calif.; Aguilar, Colo.; Jasper, Fla.; Branford, Fla.; Westmont, Ill.; Winthrop, Mass.; Virginia, Minn.; Starkville, Miss.; Indiana, Pa.; Memphis, Tenn.; and Carrollton, Texas.

Kuipers Ace Hardware is part of Ace's hardware cooperative, which is the largest in the world and serves 9,050 locally owned and operated stores worldwide. The Oak Brook, Ill.-based hardware cooperative has 5,300 independently owned retail stores in the U.S.

The 102-year-old hardware chain reported $2.5 billion in revenue, or a 2.1% increase year-over-year, in the third quarter of 2026 ended Oct. 3. About 4,000 Ace retail stores that share daily retail sales data reported a 2% increase in same-store sales supported by a 4.5% increase in average ticket, though same-store transactions declined by 2.3%.

articles.title: Skims’ $148 advent calendar flop wasn’t a stunt, marketers say—but store credit may not win back Kim Kardashian’s angry customers
articles.summary: A theory holds that the hair-tie-filled calendar and its keep-it-for-credit refund offer were a calculated play for repeat spending. Consumer researchers and...
articles.body:
"We might be on track for the worst advent calendar I've ever opened," content creator Kayla Ryan said in a TikTok video this week, referring to the $148 Skims 12-day advent calendar that customers have been ripping apart for the past several days.

"I could get these at Dollar Tree ," she continued, pulling three unpacked hair ties from the day three slot on the advent calendar. The $148 box held keychains, bobby pins, scrunchies, and hair ties—but none of the bodysuits or loungewear that made Kim Kardashian's company so popular.

Countless videos like Ryan's have flooded social media for the past several days, prompting Skims to scramble to contain the fallout. In response to the online outrage, the company "personally contacted every customer who purchased the calendar and offered them a choice of a full refund or a SKIMS credit to put towards other products," a spokesperson told other outlets.

Skims did not respond to multiple requests for comment from Fortune .

The catch, according to the email buyers received, is that a cash refund means sending the calendar back, while shoppers who opt for store credit keep it. That detail led to some theories that Skims had purposefully rage-baited customers.

"Skims knew what they were doing with that advent calendar. I'd bet money it was intentional," Jessica Tillery, a senior vice president of brand communications for Allison Worldwide, wrote in a LinkedIn post this week.

"Every dollar spent over that $148 credit is new revenue for them," Tillery wrote. "Every person who comes back to shop with that credit is a repeat purchaser."

Data shows gift-card overspending does happen. Nearly 60% of shoppers say they'd go past a card's balance when using it, spending $73 more on average, according to Blackhawk Network's 2026 research . A 2025 study by Northwestern Kellogg School of Management lecturer Ata Jami also found shoppers are more likely to spend money they get back from returns, and more inclined to splurge with it, since it doesn't sting the way spending regular cash does.

Why some execs think the marketing stunt theory falls apart

But other marketers and consumer researchers who spoke with Fortune don't buy it. Customers who feel ripped off don't spend like someone holding a birthday gift card, they say, and new social-listening data shows the negativity sticking around even as the online chatter dies down. For a company that raised $225 million last year at a $5 billion valuation , the steeper price may be shoppers' trust in the brand.

articles.title: Bets tiraram R$ 40,4 bilhões do orçamento das famílias em 2026 | G1
articles.standfirst: Valor corresponde à saída líquida estimada de recursos entre janeiro e julho. Estudo aponta que dívidas já comprometem quase 30% da renda das famílias.
articles.summary: Valor corresponde à saída líquida estimada de recursos entre janeiro e julho. Estudo aponta que dívidas já comprometem quase 30% da renda das famílias.
articles.body:
Pessoa mexendo no celular — Foto: Reprodução/ RBS TV

O avanço das casas de apostas online segue consumindo uma parcela relevante dos recursos das famílias brasileiras. Nos primeiros sete meses de 2026, a saída líquida de recursos associada às bets foi estimada em R$ 40,4 bilhões.

Os dados são do 4º Boletim Fiscal dos Estados Brasileiros, produzido pelo Comsefaz em parceria com o Centro Internacional Celso Furtado de Políticas para o Desenvolvimento (Cicef), com apoio do Grupo de Gestores das Finanças Estaduais (Gefin).

Em todo o ano de 2025, o volume de transferências líquidas associado às bets foi estimado em R$ 62,5 bilhões.

Para calcular a saída líquida, o estudo compara quanto dinheiro as pessoas enviaram às empresas desse segmento e quanto receberam de volta. O cálculo usa dados do Banco Central (BC) sobre a categoria de artes, cultura, esporte e recreação, que também inclui as plataformas de apostas.

⚠️ Para estimar quanto do aumento pode estar associado às bets, os pesquisadores também projetaram como as transferências teriam evoluído caso o padrão observado até agosto de 2024 tivesse continuado. A diferença entre essa projeção e o que efetivamente ocorreu é usada como estimativa do impacto da expansão das apostas.

Os próprios autores destacam, porém, que não é possível atribuir toda essa diferença exclusivamente às bets, já que a categoria analisada pelo Banco Central também inclui outras atividades.

Considerando todo o período entre outubro de 2024 e julho de 2026, o estudo calcula uma saída líquida adicional média de R$ 4,85 bilhões por mês associada às bets.

"Esse montante representa uma transferência substancial de renda das famílias para o setor, com impacto potencial sobre sua capacidade de honrar compromissos financeiros", afirma o estudo.

O documento também afirma que a proibição de apostas para beneficiários do Bolsa Família, adotada em outubro de 2025, teve efeito mensurável sobre o volume de recursos movimentados.

"[Isso] sugere que as famílias de menor renda tinham participação relevante nesse mercado, o que, combinado ao elevado endividamento e comprometimento de renda, reforça o diagnóstico de fragilidade financeira das famílias brasileiras no ciclo atual", diz o estudo.

Dívidas já consomem quase 30% da renda das famílias

Além dos gastos com apostas, as famílias brasileiras enfrentam um nível recorde de comprometimento da renda com dívidas.

Segundo o estudo, 28,9% da renda das famílias estava comprometida, em junho, com o chamado serviço da dívida, que inclui o pagamento de juros e amortizações. O percentual é recorde na série histórica e representa uma alta de 1,7 ponto percentual (p.p.) em 12 meses.

Só os juros consumiam 10,9% da renda das famílias, ante 9,85% um ano antes. Segundo o estudo, parte desse aumento reflete a manutenção da taxa básica de juros (Selic) em patamar elevado ao longo de 2025 e no início de 2026.

O endividamento das famílias, por sua vez, ficou em 49,75% em junho, próximo do recorde de 49,9% registrado em janeiro deste ano.

O indicador de endividamento mede o tamanho das dívidas das famílias em relação à renda acumulada em 12 meses.

articles.title: 'Prévia' do PIB do BC registra tombo de 0,9% no 3º trimestre, maior queda desde a pandemia | G1
articles.standfirst: Esse foi o primeiro resultado negativo desde o terceiro trimestre do ano passado, que foi de -0,28%. O resultado pelo BC foi calculado após ajuste sazonal.
articles.summary: Esse foi o primeiro resultado negativo desde o terceiro trimestre do ano passado, que foi de -0,28%. O resultado pelo BC foi calculado após ajuste sazonal.
articles.body:
O Banco Central informou nesta segunda-feira (16) que o Índice de Atividade Econômica (IBC-Br), considerado a "prévia" do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB), recuou 0,9% no terceiro trimestre deste ano.

O resultado foi calculado pelo BC com ajuste sazonal, que permite comparar períodos diferentes ao descontar efeitos típicos de cada época do ano. A queda foi registrada em relação ao segundo trimestre de 2026.

O dado divulgado pelo Banco Central mostra uma forte desaceleração da atividade econômica, após o IBC-Br ter registrado crescimento de 0,27% no segundo trimestre de 2026.

O tombo do IBC-Br no terceiro trimestre deste ano foi a primeira desde o mesmo período de 2025, quando o indicador recuou 0,28%.

Essa também foi a maior queda do indicador desde o segundo trimestre de 2020, em meio à pandemia de Covid-19, quando houve uma retração de 10%.

No trimestre, todos os setores da economia registraram queda:

O PIB é a soma de todos os bens e serviços finais produzidos no país e é usado para medir o desempenho da economia. Já o IBC-Br é calculado de forma diferente, com um conjunto mais restrito de informações. (veja mais abaixo nesta reportagem)

O resultado oficial do PIB do terceiro trimestre deste ano, medido pelo Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), será divulgado em 2 de dezembro.

🔎 Quando o PIB cresce, significa que a economia está produzindo mais bens e serviços. Quando cai, indica uma retração da atividade econômica. O crescimento do PIB, porém, nem sempre se traduz em melhora do bem-estar da população.

Em um ano eleitoral, o governo adotou uma série de medidas para estimular a economia e reduzir o endividamento da população, buscando impulsionar o consumo de produtos e serviços.

A equipe econômica ampliou a isenção do Imposto de Renda para quem ganha até R$ 5 mil e liberou recursos do Fundo de Garantia do Tempo de Serviço (FGTS), além de oferecer linhas de crédito mais baratas à população. O governo também anunciou o perdão de dívidas de microempreendedores individuais.

Essas medidas, porém, podem dificultar o controle da inflação ao estimular o consumo. O BC tem afirmado que a desaceleração da economia, ou seja, um ritmo menor de crescimento, faz parte do processo de contenção das pressões inflacionárias.

Nesse cenário, a instituição tem mantido a taxa básica de juros em patamar elevado. Atualmente em 13,75% ao ano , a Selic coloca o Brasil entre os países com os maiores juros reais do mundo.

▶️ Na ata da última reunião do Comitê de Política Monetária (Copom), divulgada na semana passada, o BC informou que o chamado "hiato do produto" continua positivo.

Isso significa que a economia está operando acima de seu nível potencial, o que tende a aumentar as pressões sobre a inflação.

O mercado financeiro projeta uma desaceleração da economia em 2026. A estimativa dos analistas é de crescimento de 1,72% neste ano, ante uma expansão de 2,3% em 2025. Para 2027, a previsão é de uma alta ainda menor, de 1%.

De acordo com o Banco Central, o IBC-Br recuou 0,2% em setembro, na comparação com agosto. O resultado representa uma piora em relação a agosto, quando o indicador havia registrado uma leve alta de 0,1%.

Na comparação com setembro de 2025, a prévia do PIB do BC ficou estável, sem ajuste sazonal.

Ainda segundo o Banco Central, o IBC-Br acumulou crescimento de 1,4% de janeiro a setembro, na comparação com o mesmo período de 2025.

No acumulado de 12 meses até setembro, a expansão também foi de 1,4%. Nesses casos, o índice foi calculado sem ajuste sazonal.

Os resultados do IBC-Br são considerados a "prévia do PIB". Porém, o cálculo do Banco Central é diferente do cálculo do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE).

O indicador do BC incorpora estimativas para a agropecuária, a indústria e o setor de serviços, além dos impostos, mas não considera o lado da demanda (incorporado no cálculo do PIB do IBGE).

O IBC-Br é uma das ferramentas usadas pelo BC para definir a taxa básica de juros do país. Com o maior crescimento da economia, por exemplo, teoricamente haveria mais pressão inflacionária, o que poderia contribuir para conter a queda dos juros.

articles.title: PIX completa seis anos com mais de 1 bilhão de chaves registradas e mirando ligação com outros países | G1
articles.standfirst: Nascido em 2020, o 'ecossistema' de pagamentos instantâneos passou por um intenso processo de evolução e tem novidades previstas para o futuro. Em 2025, a ferramenta registrou movimentação de R$ 35,36 trilhões, um novo recorde.
articles.summary: Nascido em 2020, o 'ecossistema' de pagamentos instantâneos passou por um intenso processo de evolução e tem novidades previstas para o futuro. Em 2025, a ferramenta registrou movimentação de R$ 35,36 trilhões, um novo recorde.
articles.body:
O PIX, sistema de pagamentos instantâneos criado pelo Banco Central, completou seis anos nesta segunda-feira (16) com mais de 1 bilhão de chaves registradas.

Criado em 2020, o sistema passou por diversas mudanças e tem novidades previstas para os próximos anos, como o PIX internacional . (veja mais abaixo nesta reportagem)

De acordo com o BC, no primeiro ano de funcionamento do PIX, 85% das transações eram realizadas entre pessoas físicas.

Em outubro de 2026, as transações de pessoas físicas para empresas (P2B, na sigla em inglês) representaram 45% do total, consolidando o PIX no dia a dia do comércio varejista.

Já nas transações entre empresas (B2B, na sigla em inglês), o volume financeiro representou 52% de todo o dinheiro movimentado pelo sistema.

No ano passado, a ferramenta de transferências do Banco Central movimentou R$ 35,36 trilhões , um novo recorde, em quase 80 bilhões de transações . Neste ano, até outubro, foram contabilizadas 76 bilhões de transações, alta de 17,6% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025.

“Em seus seis anos de trajetória, o PIX consolidou-se como uma infraestrutura pública digital essencial para a população brasileira, atendendo às suas necessidades de pagamento e viabilizando o surgimento de novos casos de uso e modelos de negócios. Há muito a celebrar”, afirmou Ricardo Teixeira, chefe do Departamento de Competição e de Estrutura do Mercado Financeiro do BC.

O PIX também já foi alvo de críticas do governo do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump , sob o argumento de que o sistema prejudica gigantes de cartões de crédito, como Visa e Mastercard.

Além de ser amplamente utilizado pela população brasileira, o Pix contribuiu para a inclusão de milhões de pessoas no sistema financeiro.

O sistema também impulsionou a atividade econômica, especialmente entre pequenos negócios, presenciais ou digitais, que antes enfrentavam mais dificuldades para receber pagamentos por seus produtos e serviços.

"O PIX atuou como vetor central para elevar a 96,4% a parcela de adultos com conta bancária no país e a 88% os usuários ativos no sistema financeiro nacional posicionando o Brasil entre as nações mais bancarizadas do mundo", informou o BC.

Reconhecido internacionalmente, o PIX ganhou novas funcionalidades desde seu lançamento, há seis anos.

📩 PIX Cobrança: funciona como uma alternativa ao boleto, permitindo que empresas e prestadores de serviços recebam pagamentos mais rapidamente, com identificação e controle das cobranças.

💵 PIX Saque e PIX Troco: permitem retirar dinheiro em espécie em lojas e outros estabelecimentos, ampliando os pontos de acesso ao dinheiro físico.

📅 PIX Agendado: permite programar transferências para datas futuras, facilitando a organização de pagamentos.

📱 PIX por Aproximação: disponível inicialmente em dispositivos Android, permite pagar aproximando o celular de uma máquina compatível, de forma semelhante aos cartões por aproximação.

🔄 PIX Automático: permite o pagamento de contas recorrentes, como mensalidades e assinaturas, de forma automática, após autorização do cliente.

🌐 Integração com o Open Finance: permite iniciar pagamentos por diferentes plataformas, facilitando transações em compras online e pelo celular.

➡️ O Banco Central prevê novas funcionalidades para o PIX em 2027, mas a implementação dependerá da disponibilidade de recursos.

PIX internacional: o sistema já pode ser utilizado em estabelecimentos de alguns países, como Argentina, Estados Unidos (Miami e Orlando) e Portugal (Lisboa). O BC considera que esse uso ainda é "parcial", restrito a estabelecimentos específicos. A proposta é interligar sistemas de pagamentos instantâneos de diferentes países, permitindo transferências internacionais de forma mais ampla.

PIX em garantia: a proposta é permitir que trabalhadores autônomos e empreendedores utilizem valores que têm a receber pelo PIX como garantia para empréstimos bancários. Isso poderia facilitar o acesso ao crédito e reduzir os juros cobrados.

PIX por aproximação (modelo offline): a ideia é permitir pagamentos por aproximação mesmo quando o celular do usuário estiver sem conexão com a internet, seja por Wi-Fi ou rede móvel.

➡️ O Banco Central também continua discutindo a regulamentação do PIX Parcelado , modalidade que poderá ampliar as opções de pagamento para cerca de 60 milhões de pessoas que não têm cartão de crédito.

💵 O parcelamento por meio do PIX já é oferecido por diversas instituições financeiras como uma modalidade de crédito . O BC, porém, pretende padronizar as regras para estimular a concorrência entre os bancos e, potencialmente, reduzir os juros. Essa padronização não tem prazo definido.

articles.title: Dólar dispara 2% e bate R$ 5,79, maior nível desde abril de 2025; Ibovespa cai com dúvidas sobre pacote fiscal | G1
articles.standfirst: Na sexta-feira (13), a moeda americana subiu 0,05%, cotada a R$ 5,6549. O principal índice da bolsa brasileira avançou 0,66%, aos 172.458 pontos.
articles.summary: Na sexta-feira (13), a moeda americana subiu 0,05%, cotada a R$ 5,6549. O principal índice da bolsa brasileira avançou 0,66%, aos 172.458 pontos.
articles.body:
O dólar operava em alta nesta segunda-feira (16), com avanço de 2,30% por volta das 15h40, cotado a R$ 5,7849 . Na máxima do dia, chegou a R$ 5,7939 , superando todos os fechamentos registrados desde 21 de abril de 2025, quando a moeda americana encerrou o pregão a R$ 5,8067 .

Já o Ibovespa , principal índice da bolsa brasileira, caía 2,10% no mesmo horário, aos 168.844 pontos .

As contas públicas seguem como o principal destaque da sessão, após a aprovação do texto-base de um pacote de medidas na semana passada. Investidores também avaliam os dados do IBC-Br, indicador do Banco Central considerado uma prévia do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) brasileiro, e acompanham a divulgação de resultados de empresas no exterior, com destaque para a Nvidia.

▶️ A política fiscal brasileira segue no centro das atenções. Na semana passada, o governo apresentou um pacote de medidas de corte de gastos estimado em até R$ 60 bilhões para 2027 .

O texto-base foi aprovado pelo Senado, mas a votação ainda não foi concluída: os senadores precisam analisar quatro destaques que podem alterar a proposta. Depois, o projeto seguirá para a Câmara dos Deputados. Saiba mais.

🔎 Investidores avaliam se as medidas serão suficientes para conter o crescimento dos gastos públicos e estabilizar a dívida pública. A preocupação é que um ajuste considerado insuficiente mantenha os juros elevados e pressione o dólar.

▶️ O IBC-Br caiu 0,9% no terceiro trimestre deste ano. O indicador, divulgado pelo Banco Central e considerado uma prévia do PIB, mostrou uma retração da atividade econômica, após o crescimento de 0,27% registrado entre abril e junho. A queda foi puxada principalmente pela agropecuária, que recuou 2%. A indústria caiu 1,1%, e os serviços, 0,5%.

▶️ No exterior, investidores acompanham a divulgação de balanços corporativos, com destaque para a Nvidia. As ações da empresa acumularam perdas na última semana por conta do escândalo envolvendo a saída de Jensen Huang do comando da empresa , em meio a uma investigação sobre suspeitas de espionagem chinesa.

O mercado acompanha os desdobramentos da mudança de comando e seus possíveis impactos sobre a empresa e o setor. O resultado pode trazer novos sinais sobre as perspectivas da companhia e do setor de inteligência artificial.

▶️ O mercado ainda monitora os preços do petróleo, após a Agência Internacional de Energia (AIE) indicar excesso de oferta global, mesmo em meio à guerra no Oriente Médio. Perto das 10h10, o barril do Brent , referência internacional, caía 1,43% , a US$ 94,47 . Já o West Texas Intermediate ( WTI ), referência nos Estados Unidos , recuava 1,10% no mesmo horário, a US$ 87,59 por barril.

Veja abaixo mais detalhes do dia nos mercados.

Mercado ainda vê desafios no ajuste fiscal

O Senado aprovou, na semana passada, o texto-base de um pacote de medidas do governo federal para conter o crescimento dos gastos públicos e melhorar as contas do país.

Segundo o Ministério do Planejamento, a proposta pode ter impacto de até R$ 60 bilhões em 2027: R$ 50 bilhões seriam destinados ao cumprimento das metas fiscais, enquanto outros R$ 10 bilhões abririam espaço no Orçamento para novas despesas, como o Pé-de-Meia Universitário.

limites mais rígidos para o crescimento dos gastos públicos;

possibilidade de bloquear temporariamente determinadas despesas obrigatórias;

redução de até 20% em alguns benefícios fiscais concedidos a empresas.

O texto também prevê mudanças no cálculo dos recursos mínimos destinados à saúde e estabelece um prazo para a regulamentação dos chamados supersalários do funcionalismo público.

A votação, porém, ainda não foi concluída. Quatro destaques ainda precisam ser analisados pelos senadores antes de o projeto seguir para a Câmara dos Deputados.

🔎 O objetivo do governo é conter o crescimento da dívida pública sem comprometer políticas sociais. A aprovação do pacote também é considerada importante para que o Congresso avance na votação do Orçamento de 2027.

Os resultados da Nvidia ficarão no centro das atenções dos mercados globais nesta segunda-feira. Os números podem dar novas indicações sobre o desempenho da companhia em meio à crise que levou à saída de Jensen Huang, fundador e ex-presidente-executivo da empresa.

O Conselho de Administração anunciou, na última quinta-feira (12), a saída de Huang dos cargos de presidente, diretor-executivo e integrante do colegiado. A decisão teve efeito imediato.

O fundador da Nvidia admitiu ter sido infiel à esposa após a revelação de um relacionamento com Alice Huang, empresária chinesa suspeita de atuar em uma operação de espionagem ligada a Pequim. Apesar do sobrenome em comum, ela não tem parentesco com Jensen.

Na Ásia , as ações chinesas fecharam em queda, próximas do menor nível desde julho de 2025. O recuo foi puxado pelos papéis do setor de hardware, em meio às preocupações com a sustentabilidade da valorização das empresas ligadas à inteligência artificial.

Sinais de fraqueza da economia global também pesaram sobre os mercados, assim como as preocupações envolvendo a Nvidia.

O SSEC , índice de Xangai, caiu 0,87%, enquanto o CSI 300 , que reúne grandes empresas negociadas nas bolsas de Xangai e Shenzen, recuou 0,91%. Já o Nikkei , do Japão, teve perdas de 2,42% e o Kospi , da Coreia do Sul, desvalorizou 3,59%. Em Hong Kong, o índice Hang Seng subiu 0,49%.

articles.summary: Mais de 500 servidores do Fisco e centenas de integrantes de órgãos parceiros participaram da operação, que teve início no dia 3 de novembro e se encerrou na última sexta (13).
articles.body:
A Receita Federal informou nesta segunda-feira (16) que foram apreendidos R$ 581 milhões em mercadorias ilegais e drogas por meio de uma mega operação.

Mais de 500 servidores do Fisco e centenas de integrantes de órgãos parceiros participaram da operação Fronteira, que teve início no dia 3 de novembro e se encerrou nesta sexta-feira (13).

Resultados da Operação Fronteira em 2026 — Foto: Receita Federal

Realizada anualmente desde 2021, a operação é a maior iniciativa da Receita Federal voltada à vigilância e repressão em pontos de fronteira terrestre, marítima e aérea. O foco está no combate ao contrabando, descaminho e outros ilícitos como tráfico de drogas, armas, fauna e flora .

O Fisco informa que as operações de combate ao contrabando também visam assegurar a justiça fiscal ao promover concorrência leal no mercado interno.

De acordo com o secretário da Receita Federal, Robinson Barreirinhas, o alto volume de apreensões aconteceu sem a troca de um tiro.

"Não é sorte, são meses de planejamento. Não houve alvos aleatórios, tudo foi planejado", disse.

Durante a operação foram apreendidos 408 iPhones de origem estrangeira, introduzidos irregularmente no país. Essa abordagem ocorreu na cidade de Maringá, no Contorno Sul. Uma camionete, que vinha da fronteira, foi abordada e nela foi encontrado um fundo falso na caçamba.

Já no Porto de Santos, o Fisco apreendeu:

217 mil unidades de dispositivos eletrônicos para fumar, popularmente conhecidos como cigarros eletrônicos ou vapes, com valor estimado de R$ 20 milhões.

uma tonelada de rolamentos falsificados, avaliados em R$ 350 mil.

11 kg de cocaína acondicionados em um contêiner refrigerado, na área reservada aos componentes responsáveis por sua refrigeração.

articles.title: Mercado eleva estimativa de inflação para 5% em 2027 e prevê corte menor nos juros  | G1
articles.standfirst: Expectativas são divulgadas toda semana pelo Banco Central (BC), com base em pesquisa realizada com mais de 100 instituições financeiras. Recorte de agora faz referência à semana passada.
articles.summary: Expectativas são divulgadas toda semana pelo Banco Central (BC), com base em pesquisa realizada com mais de 100 instituições financeiras. Recorte de agora faz referência à semana passada.
articles.body:
Os economistas do mercado financeiro elevaram novamente a estimativa de inflação em 2027 e passaram a projetar um corte menor de juros no ano que vem.

As informações fazem parte do "Boletim Focus", divulgado nesta terça-feira (16) pelo Banco Central (BC), com base em pesquisa realizada na última semana com mais de 100 instituições financeiras.

➡️ Para 2026, a estimativa de inflação caiu de 5,22% para 5,11%;

➡️ Para 2027, a expectativa subiu de 4,90% para 5%;

➡️ Para 2028, a previsão continuou em 4%;

➡️ Para 2029, a estimativa permaneceu em 4%.

🔎 Por que isso importa? Quanto maior a inflação, menor é o poder de compra da população — especialmente entre quem recebe salários mais baixos. Isso ocorre porque os preços sobem, enquanto os salários não acompanham esse aumento.

Para o crescimento do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) deste ano, o mercado financeiro reduziu sua estimativa de 1,75% para 1,72% na semana passada.

Com isso, os analistas estimam desaceleração da economia neste ano , visto que, em 2025, o PIB cresceu 2,3% , conforme divulgação oficial do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística ( IBGE ).

➡️ O Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) é a soma de todos os bens e serviços produzidos no país e serve para medir o desempenho da economia.

🔎Se o PIB cresce, significa que a economia vai bem e produz mais. Se o PIB cai, quer dizer que a economia está encolhendo. Entretanto, nem sempre crescimento do PIB equivale a bem-estar social.

Para 2027, a projeção do mercado de crescimento do PIB caiu de 1,15% para 1,02%.

Para 2028, a estimativa do mercado para a expansão da economia permaneceu em 1,80%.

Em um ano eleitoral, o governo adotou ações para estimular a economia e reduzir o endividamento da população, o que impulsiona a demanda por produtos e serviços.

A estratégia do governo, porém, dificultou o controle da inflação. O BC tem dito claramente que uma desaceleração, ou seja, um ritmo menor de crescimento da economia, faz parte da estratégia de conter as pressões inflacionárias.

Após reeleição de Lula, mercado financeiro vê inflação mais alta e piora bastante previsão para taxa de juros e dólar. — Foto: Foto: Rafa Neddermeyer/Agência Brasil

Após a decisão do BC de manter o juro estável em 13,75% ao ano na semana retrasada, os analistas do mercado financeiro passaram a projetar estabilidade na taxa neste ano e um corte menor em 2027.

A estimativa do mercado para a taxa Selic ao fim de 2026 permaneceu em 13,75% ao ano na última semana.

Para o fechamento de 2027, a projeção do mercado subiu de 12,5% para 12,75% ao ano.

Para o fim de 2028, a estimativa dos analistas permaneceu em 11% ao ano.

Para o fim de 2029, a expectativa dos analistas subiu de 10,25% para 10,5% ao ano.

O mercado financeiro elevou sua estimativa para a taxa de câmbio ao fim deste ano de R$ 5,35 para R$ 5,40 por dólar.

Para o fechamento de 2027, a projeção dos economistas dos bancos avançou de R$ 5,40 para R$ 5,45 por dólar.

Para o fim de 2028, a expectativa do mercado para o dólar passou de R$ 5,45 para R$ 5,48.

Já para o fechamento de 2029, continuou em R$ 5,50 por dólar.

articles.title: Avião comercial 100% elétrico faz primeiro voo tripulado na China; VÍDEO | G1
articles.standfirst: Aeronave tem capacidade para 19 passageiros e autonomia projetada de 400 quilômetros. Modelo ainda passa por testes e não tem previsão para iniciar operações comerciais.
articles.summary: Aeronave tem capacidade para 19 passageiros e autonomia projetada de 400 quilômetros. Modelo ainda passa por testes e não tem previsão para iniciar operações comerciais.
articles.body:
A China realizou no sábado (14) o primeiro voo tripulado de um avião comercial totalmente elétrico , desenvolvido para transportar até 19 passageiros em viagens de curta distância. O teste ocorreu na cidade de Binzhou, na província de Shandong, no leste do país.

Segundo a agência estatal chinesa Xinhua, a aeronave, chamada CE-25A, foi desenvolvida pela fabricante estatal Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC), em parceria com outras instituições chinesas.

O avião transportou dois pilotos e um engenheiro responsável pelos testes. A operação durou 57 minutos e 46 segundos, dos quais 16 minutos foram efetivamente de voo. Nesse período, a aeronave percorreu 60,4 quilômetros.

De acordo com a COMAC, todos os sistemas funcionaram normalmente e os resultados ficaram dentro do esperado.

🔎 O CE-25A é o primeiro avião comercial elétrico desenvolvido pela fabricante. O modelo foi projetado principalmente para conectar cidades próximas, com capacidade para transportar passageiros em trajetos de até 400 quilômetros.

Entre as principais características da aeronave estão:

Avião comercial elétrico CE-25A, desenvolvido na China para transportar até 19 passageiros, durante seu primeiro voo tripulado, realizado no sábado (14), na cidade de Binzhou, na província de Shandong. — Foto: Reprodução/Reuters

O voo tripulado marca uma nova etapa dos testes do CE-25A. Em fevereiro deste ano, a aeronave realizou seu primeiro voo autônomo, sem pessoas a bordo.

Desde então, acumulou 19 voos de teste não tripulados, segundo informações divulgadas pela agência chinesa Xinhua.

O projeto é desenvolvido pela COMAC em parceria com a fabricante de baterias CATL, a Universidade Jiao Tong de Xangai e outras instituições chinesas.

✈️ A China, porém, não é pioneira no desenvolvimento de aviões elétricos. Em 2022, a empresa americana Eviation realizou um voo experimental com o Alice, modelo projetado para transportar nove passageiros.

A aeronave chinesa, com capacidade anunciada para 19 pessoas, representa mais um avanço nas pesquisas para viabilizar o transporte aéreo comercial movido a eletricidade.

Apesar dos avanços, o CE-25A ainda não está autorizado a transportar passageiros comercialmente.

A Administração de Aviação Civil da China (CAAC) já aceitou o pedido de certificação do modelo, mas a aeronave ainda precisa passar pelas avaliações técnicas e de segurança exigidas para entrar em operação.

Até o momento, não há previsão anunciada para o início dos voos comerciais.

articles.title: Jimmy Tata, Ratan Tata’s younger brother, backs N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment & Tata Sons listing
articles.summary: In a fresh development in the Tata group tussle, Jimmy Naval Tata has supported the continuation of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman for a third
articles.body: In a fresh development in the Tata group tussle, Jimmy Naval Tata has supported the continuation of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman for a third term. Jimmy Tata is the younger brother of the late Tata group patriarch Ratan Tata. He is also the longest-serving perpetual trustee of Sir Ratan Tata Trust (SRTT).His views have come to light as the Tata group faces an intensifying battle over control. The Tata Sons board and Noel Tata, who chairs Tata Trusts, the company’s majority shareholder, have been at loggerheads over several issues.Not only that, Jimmy Tata has also backed the Reserve Bank of India’s position that the group’s holding company should meet the listing requirements prescribed for upper-layer non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), people familiar with the matter told ET.Who is Jimmy Tata?Jimmy is the younger son of Naval Tata and his first wife, Sooni Commissariat. Noel Tata, born to Naval Tata and his second wife, Simone Dunoyer, is Jimmy’s half-brother.He is the second-largest individual shareholder of Tata Sons after Noel Tata, with a 0.81% stake in the company, equivalent to 3,262 shares. An analysis by the financial daily, based on estimates provided by investment bankers, has valued his holding at between Rs 7,000 crore and Rs 10,000 crore.Jimmy Tata has been associated with SRTT as a trustee since 1989 and is one of its three perpetual trustees, alongside Noel Tata and Jehangir Jehangir.He also serves as a trustee of the Bai Hirabai Jamsetji Tata Navsari Charitable Institution and Sarvajanik Seva Trust. Both are among the charitable trusts operating under the Tata Trusts umbrella.The 85-year-old, who leads a reclusive life in Pune and has seldom participated in or voted at Tata Trusts meetings, is understood to have shared these views in a documented exchange with another trustee.That trustee subsequently briefed a few others on the conversation, the people quoted in the report said. Jimmy Tata has also expressed his views on the functioning and governance of Tata Trusts.Jimmy Tata and fellow Pune resident Jehangir Jehangir have remained among the least visible members of the Tata trustee community. Neither has publicly disclosed their position on the ongoing struggle over control of the Tata group.Although Jimmy Tata generally avoids attending trustee meetings and voting on matters, he has been known to communicate extensively with trustees and board members through correspondence, setting out his positions on a range of subjects in considerable detail. In a 2016 interview, he gave reporters from The Times of India a file containing hundreds of such letters.It is not known whether Jimmy Tata has continued writing to trustees and board members in recent years, particularly after leaving his Colaba apartment and retreating into a more private life in Pune. His last public appearance was during the funeral and associated events following the death of Ratan Tata in late 2024. Under Ratan Tata’s will, a share in the family’s Juhu Bungalow was bequeathed to Jimmy.According to people familiar with the matter, Jimmy Tata has continued to keep a close watch on developments within the trusts, including the disagreements and disputes that have surfaced since his elder brother’s death.During his recent exchange with a fellow trustee, Jimmy Tata reportedly voiced concern over what he considers a deterioration in the standards of the institutions. He is understood to have called for them to return to the principles and objectives that guided their establishment, the people said.It remains uncertain whether his views will have any immediate impact on the current developments. Their influence could depend on whether he decides to exercise his voting rights at SRTT meetings.Jimmy Tata is also understood to favour limiting representation of the Tata family on the boards of the trusts to a single member, instead of allowing several family members to hold positions of influence. He is understood to have stressed that the institutions were created to serve the country and support nation-building, and that their operations should be guided by these philanthropic and public-interest goals rather than family interests.Favours Chandrasekaran’s reappointmentHis backing for Chandrasekaran’s reappointment and the RBI’s listing requirement places him on the opposite side of the debate from Noel Tata. Noel has opposed both the proposed listing of Tata Sons and Chandrasekaran’s continuation as chairman. The differences highlight a wider disagreement over leadership, governance and the ownership structure of the group’s holding company.Together, the Tata Trusts hold around 66% of Tata Sons, of which SRTT owns 23.56%. This gives the trusts a pivotal role in decisions affecting the future of Tata Sons and the broader conglomerate.The RBI has maintained that Tata Sons, which is classified as an upper-layer non-banking financial company (NBFC), must adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements, including listing its shares on a recognised stock exchange.Under RBI regulations, an NBFC designated as an upper-layer entity must list its equity shares within three years of being placed in that category. Tata Sons falls under this classification, and the central bank has rejected its application to surrender its registration as a core investment company.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: Wholesale inflation jumps to 12.29% in October due to rising crude and power prices
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Wholesale inflation gathered pace in October, with the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) rising 12.29% year-on-year, compared with 11.39% in
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Wholesale inflation gathered pace in October, with the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) rising 12.29% year-on-year, compared with 11.39% in September. The increase was largely driven by a steep rise in fuel and power prices, which recorded a much sharper inflation rate during the month, according to data released by the ministry of commerce and industry on Monday.The fuel and power category saw inflation jump to 32.84% in October from 25.85% in September. Primary articles also reported a higher inflation rate, while manufactured products offered some relief with a marginal moderation.The increase in fuel and power inflation was led by a sharp acceleration in crude petroleum and natural gas prices. Inflation in this category rose to 70.80% in October, significantly higher than the 57.32% recorded in September.Mineral oils also remained a major contributor, with inflation increasing to 45.57% from 40.02% in the previous month. Electricity prices saw a turnaround, recording inflation of 8.06% in October after registering a contraction of 0.43% in September.The ministry identified mineral oils, crude petroleum and natural gas, and electricity among the key drivers of wholesale inflation during the month.Inflation in primary food articles edged up to 8.26% in October from 8.14% in September. However, the broader WPI Food Index showed a marginal easing.The index, which includes both food articles and manufactured food products, recorded inflation of 8.58% in October, compared with 8.66% in the previous month.Food articles and food products were among the key contributors to wholesale price inflation, according to the ministry.The manufactured products category recorded a marginal moderation in inflation, easing to 9.54% in October from 9.76% in September. However, some key segments within the category continued to see price pressures.Inflation in basic metals increased to 17.21% from 16.96% in September. Chemicals and chemical products also saw a rise, with inflation climbing to 17.53% from 16.74%.In contrast, manufactured food products recorded a moderation in inflation, which eased to 9.24% in October from 9.44% in the previous month.The cumulative WPI inflation rate for the April-October period of the current financial year stood at 10.14%. This is in contrast to a contraction of 0.30% recorded during the corresponding period of the previous financial year.During the seven-month period, fuel and power inflation stood at 26.37%, while manufactured products recorded inflation of 8.37%. The ministry said the October WPI figures are provisional and were compiled with a weighted response rate of 81.1%.Money habits form by age 7. Is your child learning the right ones? articles.title: India has up to 607 tonnes of primary gold metal but imported over 800 tonnes of gold in FY26 worth a record $71.98 billion; now world’s fifth largest gold importer to focus on ramping up gold mining
articles.summary: India is estimated to have around 501 million to 518 million tonnes of primary gold ore resources, containing an estimated 600 to 607 tonnes of primary
articles.body: India is estimated to have around 501 million to 518 million tonnes of primary gold ore resources, containing an estimated 600 to 607 tonnes of primary gold metal. Yet, it continues to import gold in a big way. In fact, India is the world’s fifth largest gold importer.Despite the country’s gold resources, mining activity has yet to gain significant momentum. Gaps in geological information, inadequate exploration, lengthy project development periods, the design of mining auctions and the lack of commercial viability of projects have discouraged investors from entering the sector.India’s gold mining focusNow, Niti Aayog is considering a blueprint to boost gold exploration and mining in India, with the aim of attracting investment into the sector as the country continues to import large quantities of the precious metal every year, people familiar with the discussions told ET.The proposed framework is expected to suggest fiscal incentives for gold mining and changes to the regulatory regime. These could include longer-term mining rights and a system for rating bidders, intended to draw investment while ensuring that companies have the technical capabilities needed to develop India’s gold resources sustainably, the people said.The blueprint is also likely to focus on simplifying regulatory clearances through better coordination between the Centre and state governments. Other proposed measures include adopting internationally accepted reporting standards to strengthen the quality of geological data and establishing a stable, predictable policy regime to make projects more attractive to lenders and investors.Last week, Niti Aayog vice chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri discussed a draft report titled ‘India’s Gold Mining Policy: Challenges, Learning and the Road Ahead’. Prepared by Pahle India Foundation (PIF) with support from the World Gold Council (WGC), the report examines the challenges facing the sector and the steps needed to address them. The discussions focused on how its key recommendations could be incorporated into India’s gold mining policy.Although the official think tank has reached agreement on the broader macroeconomic recommendations, it has sought more detailed inputs from PIF on specific aspects of the proposed framework.These include identifying credible bidders, ensuring that mining projects are financially viable and improving access to geospatial data to make the sector more attractive to investors, one of the people cited above said.India’s gold reserves for miningBihar accounts for the largest share of India’s known gold reserves at 44-45%, followed by Rajasthan at 25% and Karnataka at 21%. West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh account for 3% each, while Jharkhand holds 2%.India’s gold imports fell 39.9% year-on-year to $24.78 billion during April-October 2026, compared with $41.24 billion in the corresponding period, as global gold prices corrected to below $4,000 per ounce.Despite the decline, India remains the world’s fifth-largest gold importer, accounting for around 6.7% to more than 9% of the value of global gold imports.The country’s gold imports touched an all-time high of $71.98 billion, equivalent to more than 800 tonnes, in 2025-26. articles.title: Indian refiners set to benefit as global diesel inventories hit fresh lows: Report
articles.summary: Indian oil refiners could benefit from tightening global diesel supplies and sustained refining margins even if crude oil prices moderate, as falling
articles.body: Indian oil refiners could benefit from tightening global diesel supplies and sustained refining margins even if crude oil prices moderate, as falling exports from China and declining inventories in major markets are expected to support profitability, according to a report by Equirus Research.In its latest Oil & Gas Weekly Tracker, the brokerage said the tightening global diesel market could strengthen refining margins, particularly benefiting standalone refiners such as Reliance Industries.The report highlighted a sharp decline in China's diesel exports, which are expected to fall below 0.8 million tonnes in November 2026. This compares with 1.33 million tonnes in August and 1.8 million tonnes in September.China's commercial diesel inventories have also fallen to 11.1 million tonnes at the end of October, their lowest level since records began in 2011.Lower exports from China, combined with declining diesel inventories in the United States and other major markets, could intensify competition for available supplies and support global refining margins, Equirus said.Tight diesel market supports refining marginsStrong diesel cracks have already contributed to refining profitability, the brokerage noted. Diesel cracks refer to the difference between crude oil prices and the prices of refined diesel and are an important indicator of how much refiners earn from processing crude.Equirus expects sustained tightness in the global diesel market to remain favourable for Indian refiners, even if crude prices ease.The outlook comes as India's upstream oil producers continue to face challenges despite movements in international crude prices.ONGC, Oil India face production and policy concernsAccording to the report, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) and Oil India have underperformed global energy companies, with their stock performance reflecting concerns over government interventions, production growth and their ability to retain the benefits of higher crude prices.Equirus pointed to previous government interventions, including crude discounts provided by upstream companies to oil marketing companies during earlier periods of high crude prices. The introduction of windfall taxes in 2022 was another factor cited by the brokerage.These developments have created continuing uncertainty for domestic upstream producers, with concerns that additional profits could be shared with the government weighing on investor sentiment, the report said.Muted production growth, particularly at ONGC, is another challenge. Natural declines in output from existing fields and delays in bringing new projects on stream have restricted the ability of upstream companies to increase production.European gas inventories remain below seasonal averagesThe brokerage also flagged tightness in global gas markets as an important factor to watch in the coming quarters.Europe's gas storage facilities were around 71 per cent full, with net withdrawals already under way. Inventories were also materially below seasonal averages, according to the report.The assessment highlights the contrasting outlook across India's oil and gas sector, with tighter diesel supplies supporting refining margins while domestic upstream producers continue to contend with production and policy-related concerns.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: China stocks hover near July 2025 lows as AI jitters hit tech shares and weaken sentiment
articles.summary: China's stock markets ended lower on Monday, with technology shares leading the decline amid growing doubts over the strength of the artificial
articles.body: China's stock markets ended lower on Monday, with technology shares leading the decline amid growing doubts over the strength of the artificial intelligence (AI) rally. Weak domestic economic data added to investor concerns, leaving key indices hovering near their lowest levels since July 2025. The CSI300 and Shanghai Composite indices fell 0.9% each.The CSI300 has lost 14% so far this year.Technology stocks led the decline, with the 5G Communication Index dropping 7.5% to its lowest level in a year. The STAR50 Index, which tracks technology-focused stocks, fell 5.2%. Zhongji Innolight, a major maker of high-speed optical transceivers used in AI data centres, lost 12.3%.The fall came as worries over the future of the global AI boom continued to weigh on markets. articles.title: Lies, spies and sex are just one part of the Nvidia story. The real stakes are much bigger
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from the company he founded this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a subordinate and one with a woman whom US officials feared could be working with Chinese intelligence.
articles.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from the company he founded this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a subordinate and one with a woman whom US officials feared could be working with Chinese intelligence. But salacious reports about spies, lies and sex threaten to overlook the very serious issues at stake for America’s second-most valuable company. Here’s what else you need to know: Nvidia has fought to sell chips to China Huang has long advocated for selling chips in China, saying at the Milken Institute annual meeting in 2025 the market for AI chips in China would eventually reach $50 billion, an amount that “is like Boeing — not a plane — the entire company.” Washington had other ideas. The Biden administration issued restrictions on exports of the chips to keep them out of China’s hands, hoping to prevent Beijing from using the technology to advance its military and AI systems. Even after Nvidia specifically developed a less powerful chip that complied with US export regulations and could be sold in China, the Trump administration still slapped restrictions on its sale. At the time, Nvidia said that would mean a $5.5 billion hit to its bottom line. Regardless, Huang and President Donald Trump have enjoyed a close relationship. By early this year, the US government had cleared 10 Chinese companies to buy its powerful H200 chip, Reuters reported. The US has questions about Megaspeed Alice Huang was an executive at Singapore-based customer Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer. She was identified by the US government as having an affair with Jensen Huang, along with being a potential Chinese intelligence asset. Megaspeed is under investigation for potentially diverting highly coveted US semiconductors to entities in China in violation of US export controls. Megaspeed has purchased more than $4 billion worth of Nvidia chips, some analysts estimate. But Trump officials have been focused on Megaspeed for months. Some Treasury staffers believed that Megaspeed should be put on a Commerce Department blacklist because of concerns the company funneled advanced chips into China. The Commerce Department dragged its feet putting Megaspeed on the so-called “entity list,” despite Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick being briefed months ago about Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, people familiar with the matter told CNN. Megaspeed has denied any wrongdoing and said it is a “compliant and legal company.” Nvidia said its China business went to “zero” after April 2025 US trade restrictions. Commerce Secretary Lutnick is under the microscope The Commerce Department’s refusal to put Megaspeed on the entity list has led to public infighting amongst members of the Trump administration. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly accused Lutnick’s Commerce Department of delaying the labeling of Megaspeed as a national security threat. The infighting has led to some discussions over whether Lutnick should be dismissed, according to people familiar with the conversations. Trump still backs Lutnick, his longtime friend. In a statement, the White House said Trump “maintains complete confidence in the secretary and his ability to carry out the position as the most transformative Commerce Secretary in modern history.” On Friday, Lutnick voluntarily agreed to testify to the Senate Banking Committee. Megaspeed isn’t the only company facing scrutiny Another important name in this saga: Super Micro Computer. Back in March, the California-based company’s founder was charged with smuggling $2.5 billion worth of servers with Nvidia chips to China – a violation of US export laws. The company, which was not named in the indictment, said at the time it is cooperating fully with the investigation against the three accused individuals. It shows how Nvidia chips were still making their way to China despite strict export controls. Nvidia (and Wall Street) have a lot of money riding on the AI boom There’s an unfathomable amount of money flowing through the AI ecosystem. Some call it circular financing. And one of the biggest financiers is Nvidia. Over the summer, Nvidia joined forces with the likes of Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to lend out more than half a trillion dollars. That $500 billion will go to build AI infrastructure. Separately, Nvidia committed $105 billion this year toward a massive OpenAI data center. Nvidia’s strategy of backstopping deals and investing in companies that, in turn, buy its products now faces fresh scrutiny without Huang in the picture – the powerful figurehead who drove so many of those deals. One central question that remains is whether Huang lied to Nvidia’s board and to the company’s investors. Some already think so. A shareholder lawsuit filed Monday claimed Huang was deceptive when asked about his affair with Alice Huang. The former CEO could face consequences from other avenues as well. Congress also wants answers and is prepared to subpoena Jensen Huang if he doesn’t voluntarily testify, the chairman of the Senate Banking Committee said.

articles.title: Mumbai property owner gets Rs 50 lakh for redevelopment rights, but taxman denies her Section 54EC benefit and taxes it as ‘other income’ instead of ‘capital gains’; why ITAT gave relief
articles.summary: You give your property for redevelopment and get payment in lieu which you then reinvest to claim capital gains exemption.
articles.body: You give your property for redevelopment and get payment in lieu which you then reinvest to claim capital gains exemption. The Income Tax Department, however, classifies it as ‘income from other sources’ and adds it to your total income. What do you do?In one such case, the Mumbai bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) has ruled in favour of the taxpayer, holding that the payment was consideration for granting development rights in the property and was therefore taxable under the head “Capital Gains”, rather than “Income from Other Sources”.What the case is aboutA Mumbai woman received Rs 50 lakh from a property developer under a redevelopment agreement. She then invested the amount in Rural Electrification Corporation (REC) bonds to claim income tax exemption.However, the Income Tax Department treated the receipt as “Income from Other Sources” instead of capital gains, and denied her the benefit of the exemption claimed under Section 54EC of the Income Tax Act, 1961.She had filed her income tax return for assessment year 2011-12, declaring a total income of Rs 2,64,260. The return disclosed capital gains of Rs 99,060 and she claimed an exemption under Section 54EC for investment in REC bonds.The assessment was reopened in 2018 after the Assessing Officer formed the view that income chargeable to tax had escaped assessment. Following a notice under Section 148, the woman filed another return on July 14, 2018, declaring the same income.During reassessment, the officer examined a development agreement dated August 2, 2010, entered into for redevelopment of a property.According to the agreement, the owners had agreed to allow the developer to redevelop the existing building by demolishing the structure and constructing a new one. The arrangement involved 16 family members or owners, four tenants and two additional claimants on one side, and the developer on the other.The agreement provided for aggregate monetary consideration of Rs 2 crore to the owners belonging to four groups.The woman received Rs 50 lakh as her group’s share. The owners also retained the floor space index (FSI) required to construct a total carpet area of 6,400 sq ft for their residential occupation, while the remaining development potential was to be used by the developer.The woman’s position was that the payment represented consideration for granting development rights, which constituted a capital asset. She maintained that the amount had been invested in REC bonds and that the exemption under Section 54EC was therefore available.The Assessing Officer accepted that the agreement was for development and not for sale of the property. He also held that Section 50C, which deals with stamp-duty value in certain transfers of land or buildings, did not apply because the transaction did not involve a sale of the land or building itself.However, the officer took the view that the Rs 50 lakh could not be assessed as capital gains. He reasoned that the owners retained their rights in the property and would receive premises in the redeveloped building. Since the payment was non-refundable and the underlying property remained with the owners, he treated the receipt as income from other sources.The officer accordingly added Rs 50 lakh to the woman’s income, taking it to Rs 52,64,260, and initiated penalty proceedings. The Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) upheld the addition and denied the Section 54EC exemption.She then challenged the decision before the tribunal. During the pendency of the appeal, she died in early 2026. Her daughter was brought on record as her legal representative after the tribunal considered the death certificate, an affidavit and the no-objection from the other legal heir.The tribunal set aside the lower authorities’ decisions on the classification of the Rs 50 lakh receipt and directed the Assessing Officer to assess it under capital gains and allow the Section 54EC exemption in accordance with the law, subject to verification of the statutory conditions.Why the court ruled in favour of property ownerITAT Mumbai ruled that development rights qualify as a capital asset. Since the payment was made in exchange for transferring valuable rights linked to immovable property, it was liable to be taxed as capital gains.The tribunal further observed that once the receipt is classified under ‘capital gains’, the taxpayer’s claim for an exemption under Section 54EC cannot be rejected simply because the income tax officer had assessed it under the wrong head of income.The tribunal focused on the nature of the rights for which the developer had paid the Rs 50 lakh. It found that the payment was not an independent or gratuitous receipt but arose directly from the contractual arrangement under which development rights were granted.The order stated: “The consideration was therefore intrinsically connected with the rights parted with by the assessee and other owners in favour of the developer.”The tribunal held that development rights in immovable property are valuable rights and form part of the bundle of rights attached to ownership. Their transfer can constitute the transfer of a capital asset even when the owners do not sell the entire land or building.The tribunal explained: “However, from this finding, it does not follow that there was no transfer of any capital asset at all.”The fact that Section 50C did not apply was also not decisive. The tribunal noted that the absence of a sale of land or building did not mean that no capital asset had been transferred. The grant of development rights itself had to be considered for tax purposes.The tribunal also disagreed with the reliance placed by the lower authorities on the developer’s accounting treatment. The developer had treated the payment as revenue expenditure in its books, but the tribunal held that this could not determine how the receipt should be classified in the hands of the recipient.As the order stated: “The taxability of a receipt in the hands of the recipient has to be determined with reference to the nature of the right transferred by the recipient and not on the basis of the accounting treatment adopted by the payer.”The tribunal directed the Income Tax Department to examine whether the taxpayer had fulfilled the requirements of Section 54EC and grant the exemption if the prescribed conditions were met. Under this provision, the capital gains must be invested in eligible bonds within six months of the transfer of the property or development rights.The exemption is capped at Rs 50 lakh, and the bonds must be retained for the prescribed lock-in period, which is currently five years, compared with three years earlier.What it means for property ownersThe ruling has implications for property owners involved in redevelopment. ITAT Mumbai has clarified that payments received for transferring development rights must be taxed under the head ‘capital gains’ rather than ‘income from other sources’.The tribunal has also held that taxpayers can claim an exemption under Section 54EC of the Income-Tax (I-T) Act by investing the capital gains in notified bonds, provided they meet the prescribed statutory conditions. Such an investment can lower the amount of capital gains subject to tax.The decision comes at a time when redevelopment is reshaping large parts of Mumbai and its surrounding suburbs. Thousands of residents living in ageing cooperative housing societies are signing agreements with developers, often in exchange for a mix of larger homes, cash compensation, corpus funds and other benefits.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: Nvidia scandal: Singapore, US discuss Megaspeed as firm's Indonesia unit faces scrutiny
articles.summary: Singapore and the United States have agreed to continue discussions on cloud-computing firm Megaspeed, which has come under scrutiny in the Nvidia scandal.
articles.body: Singapore and the United States have agreed to continue discussions on cloud-computing firm Megaspeed, which has come under scrutiny in the Nvidia scandal. This comes as Indonesian police raided its local unit earlier this year.The developments come amid investigations into the company's former executive Alice Huang and allegations linked to the sale of Nvidia chips to Chinese customers.Singapore's minister for digital development Josephine Teo discussed the company during a meeting with US deputy secretary of state Christopher Landau in Washington last week, The Straits Times reported.The report said that Indonesian police had also raided a local Megaspeed unit as part of an inquiry requested by the US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). Investigators found unopened server racks at the premises but no graphics processing units (GPUs).Megaspeed has faced scrutiny over allegations that it helped Chinese customers access Nvidia computer chips restricted under US export controls. China has denied the allegation, while Megaspeed has not been found to have violated the rules.Meanwhile, Megaspeed confirmed that Alice Huang, a former chief executive and senior executive at the company, left on August 30, 2025. It said she no longer held any position there and described its operations as a "legitimate and lawful business"."Megaspeed does not comment on Ms Huang’s personal and private matters," the company said in an emailed statement.Alice Huang has separately come under investigation in Singapore over suspected false declarations linked to server purchases. The country's home affairs ministry said police found insufficient evidence that she had committed offences but warned her for knowingly providing inaccurate information that downplayed her role in the company.Huang, who had served as Megaspeed's chief executive, chairperson and one of its key controllers, was barred from re-entering Singapore.
